01 — Jugaad Business

Strategy. Structure. New possibilities.

Businesses evolve, markets change and circumstances shift. Sometimes an organisation needs a new direction; sometimes it needs to look more carefully at the model it already has. Jugaad Business helps businesses and entrepreneurs think through commercial challenges, assess opportunities and explore practical ways forward.

Areas of engagement

  • Business strategy and business-model evaluation
  • New ventures and business opportunities
  • Business transformation and restructuring support
  • Commercial partnerships and collaborations
  • Opportunity assessment and strategic planning
  • Connecting relevant business and industry expertise

The emphasis is on understanding the actual business situation before recommending a direction.
